title: O Praise the Name
lyrics_original: I cast my mind to Calvary
Where Jesus bled and died for me.
I see His wounds,His hands, His feet.
My Saviour on that cursed tree
His body bound and drenched in tears
They laid Him down in Joseph's tomb.
The entrance sealed by heavy stone
Messiah still and all alone
O praise the name of the Lord our God
O praise His name forever more
For endless days we will sing Your praise
Oh Lord, oh Lord our God
And then on the third at break of dawn,
The Son of heaven rose again.
O trampled death where is your sting?
The angels roar for Christ the King
O praise the name of the Lord our God
O praise His name forever more
For endless days we will sing Your praise
Oh Lord, oh Lord our God
He shall return in robes of white,
The blazing Son shall pierce the night.
And I will rise among the saints,
My gaze transfixed on Jesus' face
O praise the name of the Lord our God
O praise His name forever more
For endless days we will sing Your praise
Oh Lord, oh Lord our God
Oh Lord, oh Lord our God
Oh Lord, oh Lord our God
author_english: Martin W. Sampson, Benjamin William Hastings, Dean Michael Ussher

bible_verses.telugu: ఆత్మను గూర్చిన వాగ్దానము విశ్వాసమువలన మనకు లభించునట్లు, అబ్రాహాము పొందిన ఆశీర్వచనము క్రీస్తుయేసుద్వారా అన్యజనులకు కలుగుటకై, క్రీస్తు మనకోసము శాపమై మనలను ధర్మశాస్త్రముయొక్క శాపమునుండి విమో చించెను;
bible_verses.english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, for it is written: 'Cursed is everyone who is hung on a pole.'

bible_verses.telugu: యోసేపు ఆ దేహమును తీసికొని శుభ్రమైన నారబట్టతో చుట్టి తాను రాతిలో తొలిపించుకొనిన క్రొత్త           సమాధిలో దానిని ఉంచి, సమాధి ద్వారమునకు పెద్దరాయి పొర్లించి వెళ్లిపోయెను.
bible_verses.english: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth, and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.

bible_verses.telugu: మనము పాపముల విషయమై చనిపోయి, నీతివిషయమై జీవించునట్లు, ఆయన తానే తన శరీరమందు మన పాపములను మ్రానుమీద మోసి కొనెను. ఆయన పొందిన గాయములచేత మీరు స్వస్థత నొందితిరి.
bible_verses.english: "He himself bore our sins" in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; "by his wounds you have been healed."

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I fix my eyes on Your incredible sacrifice at Calvary. Thank You for bearing my sins in Your own body and enduring the cross for my sake. When I feel overwhelmed, help me remember the depth of Your love and the grace that bought my freedom. May my life and my voice forever overflow with praise to Your glorious name. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, I fix my eyes on Your incredible sacrifice at Calvary. Thank You for bearing my sins in Your own body and enduring the cross for my sake. When I feel overwhelmed, help me remember the depth of Your love and the grace that bought my freedom. May my life and my voice forever overflow with praise to Your glorious name. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Looking back at the cross of Calvary reminds us of the immense depth of Jesus’ love and sacrifice. On that dark day, He willingly bore our sins and sorrows, laying down His life so we might find eternal life in Him. Even in the silence of the tomb, God was bringing about our redemption. As we ponder His profound love, our hearts naturally overflow with gratitude, prompting us to praise His holy name forever.
